IHG One Rewards points

IHG One Rewards points book stays at InterContinental, Kimpton, Holiday Inn and other IHG hotels. On the AirMilesHK Marketplace, members list the IHG One Rewards points they have, and buyers make offers or request a hotel stay. When a deal is agreed, AirMilesHK holds the payment until the seller delivers.

How it works

Trading IHG One Rewards points, safely

  1. Browse or listAnyone can browse IHG One Rewards listings. Joining is free and needed to make an offer or list your own points.
  2. Make an offerBid on part of a balance, the whole account where offered, or ask the seller to book a hotel stay for you.
  3. Agree the termsThe seller accepts, counters or declines. Counter as often as you need.
  4. AirMilesHK in the middleThe buyer pays AirMilesHK, the seller delivers, and we release the payment once both sides confirm.
Most loyalty programmes, including IHG One Rewards, do not allow selling or transferring points or accounts. Please read the marketplace rules before you trade. Prefer a simple purchase? See AirMilesHK's own IHG One Rewards page.
